_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: What reference images should I make before generating a 3D model of a robot character?
Make me front, side and back views of a lantern so I can model it.
Generate a logo for my bakery.
expectations: the polywright-references skill is not invoked (a 2D design job)

evals.prompt: Make a seamless pattern for wrapping paper.
expectations: the polywright-references skill is not invoked (2D, not for a 3D model)

evals.prompt: Make quick normal and height maps from tests/fixtures/stone.png into a temp folder.
expectations: the skill ran pw.py texture (proven by the tool call) and named the normal-map convention

evals.prompt: For image-to-3D, should my character be in a T-pose?
expectations: recommends a relaxed A-pose and says why (T-pose distorts proportions; riggers want A-pose)
